query: Which product has the most lapsed policies?

results.problem_statement: Which product has the highest proportion of lapsed policies?
results.cypher_executed: MATCH (p:Policy) RETURN p.product_name, ROUND(100.0*SUM(case when p.policy_status='Lapsed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(p), 2) AS lapse_pct ORDER BY lapse_pct DESC LIMIT 1

results.problem_statement: What is the trend in lapsed policies by issuance year?
results.cypher_executed: MATCH (p:Policy) WHERE p.policy_status='Lapsed' RETURN SUBSTR(issuance_date, p.1, 4) AS year, count(p) AS lapsed ORDER BY year

results.problem_statement: What is the average premiums paid count for In-Force vs Lapsed policies?
results.cypher_executed: MATCH (p:Policy) WHERE p.policy_status IN ('In-Force','Lapsed') RETURN p.policy_status, ROUND(AVG(p.premiums_paid_count), 2) AS avg_ppc

query: How do smokers compare to non-smokers in terms of premiums?

results.problem_statement: How does a continuous attribute vary across demographic groups?
results.cypher_executed: MATCH (c:Customer) RETURN c.is_smoker, ROUND(AVG(c.age), 2) AS avg_age

results.problem_statement: What proportion of each gender are smokers?
results.cypher_executed: MATCH (c:Customer) RETURN c.gender, ROUND(100.0*SUM(case when c.is_smoker='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/count(c), 2) AS smoker_pct

results.problem_statement: How does the lapse rate compare across income tiers?
results.cypher_executed: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:HOLDS]->(p:Policy) RETURN case when p.c.annual_income < 1000000 THEN 'Low' WHEN c.annual_income < 3000000 THEN 'Mid' ELSE 'High' END AS income_tier, ROUND(100.0*sum(case when p.p.policy_status = 'Lapsed' then 1 else 0 end)/count(p), 2) AS lapse_pct ORDER BY lapse_pct DESC

query: Top performing agents by NBP achieved

results.problem_statement: Who are the top/bottom performing agents by a given KPI?
results.cypher_executed: MATCH (a:Agent) RETURN a.full_name, a.nbp_achieved ORDER BY nbp_achieved DESC LIMIT 5

results.problem_statement: What is the total NBP achieved or target per branch?
results.cypher_executed: MATCH (a:Agent) RETURN a.branch_id, ROUND(SUM(a.nbp_achieved), 2) AS total_nbp ORDER BY total_nbp DESC

results.problem_statement: What is the total NBP achieved vs target for all agents?
results.cypher_executed: MATCH (a:Agent) RETURN ROUND(SUM(a.nbp_achieved), 2) AS total_nbp_achieved, ROUND(SUM(a.nbp_target), 2) AS total_nbp_target, ROUND(100.0*SUM(a.nbp_achieved)/SUM(a.nbp_target), 2) AS overall_achievement_pct
